parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL211. Join molecule_dictionary to activities to assays to target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an inner join. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL211, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows. Do not deduplicate.
